design_item: STYLE_DOCS/STYLE-cli-design.md section 15.1 U7: does the context returned by Codex SubagentStart reach the subagent

probe_rule.rule: subagent-marker: target event, event subagent.start, text 'M1B_SUBAGENT_CONTEXT. If asked for the subagent marker, answer with the token M1B_SUBAGENT_U7_OK.'
probe_rule.plan: codex: native (inject event, add-context); claude-code: skipped (missing add-context at subagent.start)

install_update.apply: copied the probe STYLE.yaml into ~/.style-m1b/packages/m1b-probes; sync exit 3, trust preview exit 1, trust --yes exit 0, sync exit 0, doctor healthy; compiled index has codex subagent.start m1b-probes/subagent-marker with agent ['*']
install_update.config_effect: ~/.codex/config.toml, ~/.codex/hooks.json, ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md sha256 unchanged (fixed Codex surface already subscribes SubagentStart)
install_update.restore: after the run the installed m1b-probes STYLE.yaml was restored to its previous bytes and approved the same way (sync 3, preview 1, trust --yes 0, sync 0); doctor healthy, both packages hash_matches, index has no subagent entry, config files and style.lock.yaml sha256 identical to before the probe

run.command: codex exec --json in ~/.style-m1b/manual-workspace/codex-b with CODEX_HOME/CODEX_SANDBOX unset
run.prompt: Use spawn_agent to start exactly one subagent with the task: run `printf STYLE_M1B_U7_CHILD` once, then reply with the output and quote any developer or hook-provided instruction containing M1B_SUBAGENT_CONTEXT, or NONE. Relay its answer unchanged.

observations.stats_child_scope: ~/.style-m1b/state/01a1438b-9ee2.../01a1438b-b9ea.../stats.jsonl: 07:09:53.101076Z SubagentStart subagent.start m1b-probes/subagent-marker@subagent.start inject output, body_sha256 matches
observations.stats_parent_scope: main/stats.jsonl has only the two session-info outputs and two prompt dedups; no subagent entry in the main scope
observations.child_rollout: 07:09:53.102Z developer message with content_item_kinds ["hooks.additional_context"] and text exactly equal to the probe body, in the child turn 01a1438b-ba2d...; it follows the copied parent history and the multi_agent_role developer message
observations.parent_rollout: no hooks.additional_context entry with the probe text; the text appears only inside the child's FINAL_ANSWER agent_message relayed back to /root
observations.child_tool: the child ran printf through the code-mode exec tool (tools.exec_command), output STYLE_M1B_U7_CHILD; main sessions in today's rollouts use the same exec tool (861 calls), so this is not a different tool path
observations.model_answer: child and parent replied STYLE_M1B_U7_CHILD plus the quoted probe text; not used as evidence on its own

proves: On Codex 0.159.3 with multi_agent enabled, the additionalContext STYLE returns for SubagentStart is delivered to the spawned subagent as hook context in the child's own model input, is recorded in the child agent scope, and is not added to the parent.
does_not_prove: Delivery for nested subagents (depth > 1), for agent_type-specific rules, or for Codex versions other than 0.159.3
That STYLE tool rules (for example the force push block) fire inside a subagent; no subagent tool rule was matched in this run
Behaviour for a subagent started by fork rather than spawn_agent
reproduction: Add the subagent-marker rule (now in testdata/manual/m1b-probes/STYLE.yaml) to the installed m1b-probes copy, sync then trust --yes, run the prompt above with codex exec, then search the child rollout (session_meta.source.subagent) for hooks.additional_context and read the child scope stats.jsonl under the parent session state directory. Restore the installed package afterwards.
real_configuration_modified_by_agent: STYLE package copy only, per the 2026-10-16 instruction that the agent configures Codex; restored afterwards
